reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getMonthWideActionCategories and uses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and isTrackingBudget as the sibling actions do.

duplication.why: Only the income-outside-tracking skip and the expense sign flip are repeated inline, as every sibling action already does; the category selection is shared.

placement.why: Sits in server/budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)).

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and tests (plus fixture rows the tests need).

maintainability.why: Consistent with its siblings; the two-phase collect-then-write loop is a small deviation from the sibling pattern but harmless.
